maddeler.e:
نتساهل (form VI)
# نَتَسَاهَلُ (natasāhalu) /na.ta.saː.ha.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# نَتَسَاهَلَ (natasāhala) /na.ta.saː.ha.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# نَتَسَاهَلْ (natasāhal) /na.ta.saː.hal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
